svg.desc: Root README runtime architecture: application entry points call graph-core contracts; backend adapters translate those contracts into native database runtimes; Graph I/O and framework modules remain supporting integration surfaces around the same core.
svg.text: Application entry points target graph-core; adapters translate the same contracts to native graph database runtimes.
